NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Allow screen recording
patches.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE and disables secure surfaces so the app can be screen-recorded.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE from window flags so the app can be captured in screenshots.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app package (appends ".lustx" by default) and updates custom permissions and content-provider authorities. Changing the package name can break apps that hardcode their package or authorities in code.

options.title: Package name
options.description: New package name. "Default" appends ".lustx" to the original.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Rename custom permissions (incl. the dynamic-receiver permission) that use the old package.

options.title: Update provider authorities
options.description: Rename content-provider authorities that use the old package.

patches.name: Remove PairIP
patches.description: Removes the PairIP Play licensing gate (startup license check, response validation, repeated checks and paywall/kill path). Does not bypass PairIP native virtualization or Play Integrity attestation.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).
